title: Advancing bioethanol: exploring feedstock diversity, production pathways, and environmental implications

RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,1129-1159

Bioethanol production is becoming more diverse, shaped by feedstock, processing methods, regional economics, and policy. These factors influence final cost and sustainability, with circular systems producing less waste.
